Frequently asked questions

How quickly can I see progress?

Most businesses launch within a week. Visibility gains depend on your market and are tracked month by month.

Which AI platforms are covered?

Every plan starts with ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot. Higher tiers expand coverage to assistants including Perplexity, Claude, Siri and Alexa.

How do I track results?

You receive a monthly visibility report and can see referred visits in your own analytics.

Will this work for my industry?

If customers search locally for your service, the same clear-data principles apply. We confirm fit before launch.

Can I cancel?

Yes. Plans are month to month and can be canceled before the next billing cycle.
